evaluation.summary: A strong, truthful CV that integrates notes (certification, on-call, cost savings) and portfolio detail with solid metrics and clear ATS sections. Minor issues: a currency added to the Snowflake saving, a merged title/date line, a nearly empty second page, and CI/CD/Git not in searchable wording. The cover letter is specific and honest about the GCP gap but repeats the same caveat twice, has filler and a punctuation slip. The meetup talk on data contracts, relevant to the curiosity requirement, is unused.
